verdict.rationale: incident.io documents building on-call schedules with rotations and chosen participants, and markets support for configurations from single-team rotations to shadow schedules and follow-the-sun 'without manual workarounds'. Working-hours rules and imported holidays shown alongside shifts round out the scheduling picture. Missing for 10: explicit documentation of schedule layers, round-robin coverage, and per-rotation time zone settings (follow-the-sun only implies time zone handling), plus independent or hands-on corroboration.
